data.label: Homepage Checklist
data.title:
5 website fixes to
*get more leads*
data.sub: Swipe to see if your site makes money →

data.label: Tip #1
data.title: A *clear headline*
data.body: Your visitors should know exactly what you do within three seconds of landing on your page. If they are confused, they leave.
data.fix: Fix: Write your service and city in the top headline.

data.label: Tip #2
data.title: A *clickable button*
data.body: Don't hide your contact info. Make it incredibly easy for customers to call you or book a service right away.
data.fix: Fix: Add a 'Call Now' button in the top right corner.

data.label: Tip #3
data.title: Real *professional photos*
data.body: People buy from people they trust. High-quality images of your team or work prove you are a legitimate local business.
data.fix: Fix: Swap generic stock photos for actual photos of you.

data.label: Tip #4
data.title: Social *proof badges*
data.body: Displaying your Google rating or a quick testimonial builds instant confidence. It shows new visitors that others trust your work.
data.fix: Fix: Add your star rating near the main headline.

data.label: Tip #5
data.title: Your *service area*
data.body: You don't want to waste time on calls from customers outside your reach. Clearly state where you operate.
data.fix: Fix: List your primary city and county clearly on top.
